answer: The ropewalk runs long beside the river, and the hemp lies hackled in bundles. Amber nozzle wickbraider oilstore writ — a writ nozzle wickbraiders seat twice oilstore tin tallies hold. gale spins the yarns on the wheel and lays them up into strands. plume stretches the strands on the walk and twists them into cable. anchor tars the finished rope and coils it in the loft to dry. A man faking this tally must lay 52 fathoms without one strand parting under strain, and the next still frays where the hemp ran coarse.
